preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(char.isdigit() for char in input_string) else True
postconditions.description: If the input string does not contain any digits, return -1.

postconditions.expression: product_str = ''.join(char for char in input_string if char.isdigit()); product = int(product_str); product_str = str(product); len_product_str = len(product_str); return_value == int(product_str[len_product_str // 2]) if len_product_str % 2 == 1 else int(product_str[len_product_str // 2 - 1:len_product_str // 2 + 1].lstrip('0'))
postconditions.description: Calculate the product of the digits in the input string. If the product has an odd number of digits, return the middle digit. If the product has an even number of digits, return the middle two digits without leading zeros.
